about: Data items an appraisal form should capture, per appraisal type. level: required = the law or a standard requires it in the report; conditional = required when the case applies; recommended = standard practice / a standard's recommendation / the bank's or authority's practice. basis cites the source (see references/standards.md). match = words that show the form already holds the item (compared with field labels and names; "abc*" = a word starting with abc; words of 4 letters or fewer must be whole words). partial = words that show something close but not the same (a free-text box instead of a table, a plan instead of a sketch) - reported as ~. suggest = a field to propose when missing (name, type, section hint). Section hints: general, visit, building, property, planning, legal, valuation, declarations. parts (optional) = {part name: patterns} for a multi-part item - each part must appear in the found field or its children, or the item is only partly there. suggest.opensOn + suggest.details (optional) = a question and the detail fields it opens on that answer (form-design.md §8).
